key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open clipboard history at pointer

key.name: max-items
key.description: Maximum number of clipboard history entries to keep in memory (5 to 1000)

key.name: max-size-mb
key.description: Maximum allowed size in megabytes for a single clipboard entry (up to 1024 MB)

key.name: max-total-size-mb
key.summary: Max total history memory in MB
key.description: Maximum total memory in megabytes for all clipboard entries combined (50 to 4096 MB)

key.name: max-thumbnail-dimension
key.description: Maximum width or height in pixels for generating image thumbnails (larger images display a generic icon)

key.name: inactivity-timeout-sec
key.description: Maximum wait time in seconds with no incoming data before canceling read to prevent application hangs

key.name: overall-timeout-sec
key.description: Maximum total duration in seconds for reading clipboard data before canceling

key.name: enable-logging
key.description: Whether to output clipboard capture, eviction, and diagnostic logs to the system journal
